description:
Goal: Make public type constructors return their retained canonical result when an operand is the canonical bottom Ty.

Signal: `Descr::resource_of`, `ListSig::possibly_empty`, and `ListSig::non_empty` recursively call `Descr::is_empty` on an already-interned operand. They then enter the interner only to rediscover `none`, `none`, or `empty_list`. `Descr::resource_of` has exactly two callers: `Types::resource` and the resource case in `refine_widen`; list descriptor builders are reached only through their public Types constructors.

Strategy: Put the identity decisions at the Types construction boundary, which owns `core.none` and `core.empty_list`: `resource(none) -> none`, `non_empty_list(none) -> none`, and `list(none) -> empty_list`. Make resource/list descriptor builders pure (no TyCtx and no semantic query). Route resource widening through `Types::resource` so it has one authority.

TDD: First prove those three constructions preserve semantic result while causing no interner work after world creation. Exercise resource widening of bottom payload through the same path. Preserve descriptor-level emptiness only where normalization handles descriptors that do not yet have a Ty.

Deletion and docs: Delete the now-unnecessary TyCtx-based descriptor inspections and their fallible branches; document the canonical-construction invariant in the type-world guide. Run focused type and enum canaries, fmt, check, strict clippy, full workspace tests, final branch-base review, one commit, and close.
title: Return canonical empty constructions before descriptor traversal
